config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.title: Simple Scoreboard Tweaks
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.showScor: Completely show or hide the sidebar scoreboard.
Show or hide the score value displayed next to each player entry.
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.maxEntri: Maximum number of player entries shown (0 hides all entries but keeps the title).
Horizontal offset from the default position. Negative moves left, positive moves right.
Vertical offset from the default position. Negative moves up, positive moves down.
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.scale.to: Overall scale of the scoreboard as a percentage of its normal size at your GUI scale. 100 = default size.
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.backgrou: Opacity of the dark background behind each score entry row.
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.titleBac: Opacity of the dark background behind the scoreboard title.
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.textOpac: Opacity of the player name and score text in each entry row.
config.simple-scoreboard-tweaks.titleTex: Opacity of the scoreboard title text.
